what: Hook smoke test bugs found and fixed (April 10, 2026): (1) track-recall.sh glob pattern `*/**` matched ANY path with slashes — all file paths written as dir| entries. Fixed with explicit regex for trailing /** and /*. (2) Nonexistent files triggered blocking nudge because project-wide memories matched any path via scopeMatchesPath. Fixed with file existence check in pre-read-recall.sh and pre-edit-recall.sh. (3) MemoryStore constructor in hook scripts used legacy string mode which doesn't set memoriesDir — rebuilt cache was always empty. Fixed to use { projectRoot } format.
why: These bugs would recur if hook scripts are rewritten or new scripts copy the same patterns. The glob pattern bug is especially subtle — bash `*/**` means "anything with a slash" not "ends with /**".
